mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_INTERVIEW_HISTORY ( HISTORY_NUM, USER_NUM, QUESTION1, ANSWER1, QUESTION2, ANSWER2, QUESTION3, ANSWER3, QUESTION4, ANSWER4, QUESTION5, ANSWER5, INTERVIEW_DATE ) VALUES ( #{historyNum}, #{userNum}, #{question1}, #{answer1}, #{question2}, #{answer2}, #{question3}, #{answer3}, #{question4}, #{answer4}, #{question5}, #{answer5}, NVL(#{interviewDate, jdbcType=DATE}, SYSDATE) )

INSERT INTO T_INTERVIEW_RESULT ( HISTORY_NUM, USER_NUM, CONFIDENCE_SCORE, PERSISTENCE_SCORE, EXPERTISE_SCORE, LOGIC_SCORE, DELIVERY_SCORE, TOTAL_SCORE, INTERVIEW_DATE ) VALUES ( #{historyNum}, #{userNum}, #{confidenceScore}, #{persistenceScore}, #{expertiseScore}, #{logicScore}, #{deliveryScore}, #{totalScore}, NVL(#{interviewDate, jdbcType=DATE}, SYSDATE) )
mapper.select: SELECT HISTORY_NUM, USER_NUM, CONFIDENCE_SCORE, PERSISTENCE_SCORE, EXPERTISE_SCORE, LOGIC_SCORE, DELIVERY_SCORE, TOTAL_SCORE, INTERVIEW_DATE FROM T_INTERVIEW_RESULT WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum} ORDER BY INTERVIEW_DATE DESC, HISTORY_NUM DESC

SELECT HISTORY_NUM, USER_NUM, QUESTION1, ANSWER1, QUESTION2, ANSWER2, QUESTION3, ANSWER3, QUESTION4, ANSWER4, QUESTION5, ANSWER5, INTERVIEW_DATE FROM T_INTERVIEW_HISTORY WHERE HISTORY_NUM = #{number} AND USER_NUM = #{userNum}

SELECT HISTORY_NUM, USER_NUM, CONFIDENCE_SCORE, PERSISTENCE_SCORE, EXPERTISE_SCORE, LOGIC_SCORE, DELIVERY_SCORE, TOTAL_SCORE, INTERVIEW_DATE FROM T_INTERVIEW_RESULT WHERE HISTORY_NUM = #{number} AND USER_NUM = #{userNum}

SELECT HISTORY_NUM, USER_NUM, CONFIDENCE_SCORE, PERSISTENCE_SCORE, EXPERTISE_SCORE, LOGIC_SCORE, DELIVERY_SCORE, TOTAL_SCORE, INTERVIEW_DATE FROM T_INTERVIEW_RESULT WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum} ORDER BY INTERVIEW_DATE DESC, HISTORY_NUM DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
